game.title: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora
game.blurb: Open-world first-person action-adventure on Pandora's Western Frontier, from Massive Entertainment, released 2023-12-07. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Campaign
chapters.summary: The main campaign from start to finish, with its hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Fighting the RDA
chapters.summary: RDA installations and outposts, stealth finishers, smashing things from your ikran and AMP suits.

chapters.title: Nature, Hunting and Gathering
chapters.summary: Saplings and bellsprigs, Hunter's Guide entries, the thanator, the Steady Wings side quest and cleaning the air.

chapters.title: Collectibles and Activities
chapters.summary: Kites, dolls, comics, audio logs, notes, recon retrievals, research points, wind flutes, totems, moths and the Mycelium Network.

chapters.title: Skills, Cooking and Crafting
chapters.summary: Ancestor, Apex and skill-tree unlocks, specialty recipes and crafting superior and legendary gear.

chapters.title: From the Ashes and Later Additions
chapters.summary: The From the Ashes content, its gear sets and Zeykoma Fruit.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora" or "Avatar Frontiers of Pandora". avatar.fandom.com and james-camerons-avatar.fandom.com both answer the API but have no page under either title, so Fandom is unverified. The Steam schema calls the app "HOPE" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2840770. RAWG also lists "Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora — From the Ashes" (2025-12-19) as a separate entry, and two Steam achievements name From the Ashes, so it has its own chapter; "Eywa's Blessing" (Zeykoma Fruit) sits there because it is next to them in the Steam list with a similar low unlock rate, though the data does not say it belongs to it. 17 of 52 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the campaign chapter, but the five at the very end of the Steam list ("Out-of-Body Experience" to "Return to Eywa") may well belong to From the Ashes or another later addition. "Path of Temrey" has no real description (it just repeats its name), so it sits in the skills chapter as a placeholder.
